name: Nami Tail Physics
creator: suriin
description:
*Not including Coven and Sunken Shadows

## Important info

This will clash with any custom skin that modifies Nami skins (not including Coven and Sunken Shadows). If you want to load other custom skins for Nami on top of this one, you should make this file load first and any other custom skin after this. The physics will work only on the riot skins, custom skins will not be affected.

## Description

**Author**: Suriin

**Skin**: All Nami skins below legendary tier

**Affects**: Tail animations

Coven and Sunken Shadows not affected because they already have physics on their tentacles.
